neighbours.label: the slot just before 'excess', 'extra' or 'surplus', as in 'drain off any ___' or 'waste products and ___' (predicting the word; the - pole is the word itself)
fire: Let the pan cool, then drain off any excess oil.
After frying the bacon, pour out any extra grease.
Snip the thread and trim away any excess fabric.
Use up any surplus paint on the back fence.
The kidneys filter out waste products and excess salts.
Sweat glands get rid of waste products and extra fluid.
Sell any surplus electricity back to the local grid.
Wring the cloth and blot off any excess water.
quiet: Let the pan cool, then wash off the burnt oil.
After frying the bacon, tell me if you need any help.
Snip the thread and fold over the loose fabric.
Use the white paint on the back fence.
The kidneys sit below the ribs on either side of the spine.
Sweat glands are found in the skin and help with cooling.
Do you have any electricity at the cabin tonight?
Wring the cloth and hang it over the rail.

notes: The + output promotes ' extra', ' excess', ' surplus' and the - pole fires on those words, so the poles are the slot and its filler. Probe readings vary (0.06 to 0.74), so this may miss the median.
